# STILL HERE

## Production
- Company: FOLD ROOM
- Production: STILL HERE
- Venue: Dock Studio
- Performance: uninterrupted dress rehearsal
- Date: 19 September 2026
- Performance window: 19:00–19:24
- Delivery: 20 September 2026, 12:00
- Venue local time: UTC+01:00
- Passages: Arrival; Crossing; Held
- Passage duration: 8 minutes each
- Cast: Mara Quill; Ellis Reed
- Audience: 24 invited adults; four rows of six seats

## Space
- Room: 8000 mm wide × 9000 mm deep
- Stage: 6000 mm wide × 4000 mm deep, centered against the rear wall
- Rear curtain: black
- Bench: one pale plywood bench, 1800 × 400 × 450 mm
- Bench position: centered across the stage, with its center 2000 mm from the rear curtain
- Stage coordinate origin: rear-left corner as viewed from the audience
- Stage x-axis: left to right from the audience viewpoint
- Stage y-axis: rear curtain toward audience
- Bench footprint: x 2100–3900 mm; y 1800–2200 mm
- Shooting access: left side aisle, right side aisle, rear aisle

## Capture
- Light source: programmed performance fixtures
- Capture mode: available light
- Still photograph shutter speeds: 1/200 second or faster
- Capture occasion: continuous dress rehearsal
- Audience view: backs of seated guests
- Photo-sequence video duration: 10 seconds

## Publication
- Production title: STILL HERE
- Feature line: A room held in common
- Company credit: FOLD ROOM
- Company emblem: three black vertical bars, relative heights 2:3:2, aligned at the bottom
- Programme: two spreads, each 296 × 210 mm at trim
- Bleed: 3 mm on all four outer edges of each spread
- Spread center fold: 148 mm from the left trim edge
- Text inset: 10 mm from trim and 8 mm on either side of the fold
- Social crop: 9:16
- Photograph proportions: landscape 3:2; portrait 2:3; social crop 9:16

## Cast appearance
- Mara Quill: age 32; medium-brown skin; short, tightly curled black hair; right-handed
- Mara costume: rust #9A4635 long-sleeved band-collar shirt; buttoned front placket; charcoal trousers; black lace-up shoes
- Ellis Reed: age 38; light skin; straight, dark-brown chin-length hair; left-handed
- Ellis costume: slate #536878 sleeveless tunic; black trousers; black slip-on shoes; one silver cuff on the left wrist
- Appearance reference order: Mara on the left; Ellis on the right

| 5 | crossing-action | S03 Mara airborne | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | held-gesture | S04 Held seated gesture | 14 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | held-detail | S05 Ellis hand and cuff detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | audience-relationship | S06 Audience and stage relationship | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | chronological-edit | Chronological photographic edit | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |
| 10 | opening-spread | Arrival and Crossing feature spread | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | closing-spread | Held feature spread | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | social-crop | S03 vertical social image | 14 | Format: PNG, 1080 by 1920 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

# STILL HERE performance records

## Run and lighting

| Passage | Time on 19 September 2026 | Cue | Stage action | Light state |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Arrival | 19:00–19:08 | L01 | Mara enters from audience-left; Ellis sits at the right end of the centered bench; Mara approaches the left end | Front wash 3200 K at 60%; side fixtures at 0% |
| Crossing | 19:08–19:16 | L02 | Both performers circle the bench; Mara makes one airborne crossing downstage of it at 19:12; Ellis stands behind the bench during that crossing | Audience-left side light 5600 K at 80%; audience-right side light 3200 K at 30%; front wash at 0% |
| Held | 19:16–19:24 | L03 | Mara sits on the left and Ellis on the right; both extend one hand toward the bench center; Ellis rests the left hand on its front edge; the shared gesture is sustained from 19:20 to 19:22 | Audience-right side light 3200 K at 40%; front wash 3200 K at 20%; audience-left side light at 0% |

| Audience-left side | Left edge, 2000 mm from rear curtain | 3000 mm | Across the bench toward audience-right |
| Audience-right side | Right edge, 2000 mm from rear curtain | 3000 mm | Across the bench toward audience-left |

steps.userMessage:
STILL HERE | A photographic feature for an intimate theatre performance

FOLD ROOM needs a photographic feature for STILL HERE, our original two-person production at Dock Studio. Photograph the uninterrupted dress rehearsal on 19 September 2026, from 19:00 to 19:24, for delivery by 12:00 on 20 September 2026. Its three eight-minute passages are Arrival, Crossing and Held. The feature should let a reader experience the change from tentative occupation to rapid movement and finally shared stillness. Build the coverage around the performance's existing staging and lighting, beginning with a written shooting plan.

The stage is 6000 mm wide and 4000 mm deep, with a black rear curtain and one pale plywood bench measuring 1800 × 400 × 450 mm. Twenty-four invited adults occupy four rows of six seats. Mara Quill wears a rust #9A4635 band-collar shirt, charcoal trousers and black lace-up shoes; Ellis Reed wears a slate #536878 sleeveless tunic, black trousers and a silver cuff on the left wrist. Their appearance follows the attached cast reference throughout. Use the programmed light cues, available-light capture and shutter speeds of 1/200 second or faster; express Held through sustained gestures and the edit's pacing. Shooting access covers the two side aisles and rear aisle during the continuous run. Audience coverage is from behind the seated guests. Print "STILL HERE" and "A room held in common" on the opening feature spread, social image and presentation cover, with the existing FOLD ROOM emblem beside the company credit.

Audience: prospective spectators, theatre programmers and cultural publication readers, supporting ticket interest, programming discussions and editorial coverage.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the commission's identity, dimensions, schedule and publication wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-performance-records.en.md supplies the cast, passage timings, light cues and shooting access records. stage-access-plan.png supplies the fixed stage geometry, lighting zones and accessible aisles. publication-windows.png supplies the programme spread and social crop geometry. cast-and-costume.png supplies the two performers' appearance and costume details. fold-room-emblem.png supplies the existing company emblem. empty-stage-light.png supplies empty-room atmosphere and working-light context.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page shooting plan with a photographic concept and six shot records, S01–S06, each stating passage, cue, performer, camera position, aspect ratio, shutter speed and editorial use
2. One camera-position map locating the six planned shots within the side and rear aisles, with sightlines and movement between positions
3. Two landscape stage photographs: S01, the complete stage during Arrival; S02, both performers and the bench during Crossing
4. Two movement photographs: S03, Mara's airborne crossing in landscape; S04, the two performers' sustained seated gesture during Held in portrait
5. One detail photograph, S05, of Ellis's left cuff and hand meeting the bench during Held
6. One audience relationship photograph, S06, connecting seated spectators' backs with both performers during Held
7. One two-page chronological photo edit containing all six photographs, passage captions and the shooting plan's shot IDs, aspect ratios and cue codes
8. Two programme feature spreads, each 296 × 210 mm with 3 mm bleed: an Arrival-to-Crossing opening and a Held closing, together reusing all six photographs
9. One vertical social image, a 9:16 crop of S03 retaining Mara's complete airborne figure
10. One 10-second photo-sequence video using S01–S06 in passage order, with Arrival, Crossing and Held as passage labels
11. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the shooting plan, camera map, six photographs, chronological edit, feature spreads and social crop, with the video represented by its sequence and timing

Acceptance:
- The shooting plan contains exactly S01–S06 and records the three passage names and cue codes L01–L03 from 03-performance-records.en.md; the chronological photo edit and presentation repeat each shot's ID, aspect ratio and cue code from that plan.
- The camera map places every viewpoint and connecting route within the access aisles on stage-access-plan.png; S01 shows the 6000 × 4000 mm stage, rear curtain and single bench, while S02 and S06 preserve their spatial relationship to the performers and seating.
- S01–S06, both feature spreads, the social image and the video preserve Mara's rust band-collar shirt and Ellis's slate tunic and left silver cuff wherever visible; their actions and light states correspond to Arrival/L01, Crossing/L02 or Held/L03 in 03-performance-records.en.md.
- The shooting plan records available-light exposures of 1/200 second or faster for all six photographs; S03 resolves Mara's airborne gesture, S04 presents the sustained seated gesture, S05 shows Ellis's left cuff, and S06 shows the audience from behind.
- The chronological edit, two feature spreads and 10-second video progress through Arrival, Crossing and Held; all six shot IDs appear in the edit and spread captions, and the social image uses S03 with Mara's complete airborne figure inside the 9:16 crop.
- Both feature spreads follow the 296 × 210 mm trim and 3 mm bleed in publication-windows.png; the opening spread, social image and presentation cover print STILL HERE and A room held in common beside the FOLD ROOM credit and emblem, and the presentation contains at least eight pages with the earlier work named above.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
